description: Stack falling blocks into tallest tower
fireSafetyLesson: Never stack things near heaters — keep 3 feet of space!
title: FLAME SPRINT 2D

description: Drag Blaze through a procedurally generated volcanic maze to the exit before time runs out.
fireSafetyLesson: Plan your escape route — know two ways out of every room!
title: BLAZE'S THERMAL RUN

description: Aim and shoot magma bubbles — match 3+ colors to pop them all.
fireSafetyLesson: Matches and lighters are tools, not toys — only grown-ups should use them!
title: RUKO'S LAVA LEAP

description: Tap to flap Boulder through crystal gates without touching them.
fireSafetyLesson: Smoke rises — if there's smoke, stay LOW under it!
title: BOULDER'S FORTRESS

description: Drag scattered pieces onto the silhouette to complete Sizzle's picture.
fireSafetyLesson: If your clothes catch fire — STOP, DROP, and ROLL!
title: SIZZLE'S TARGET POP

description: Auto-bouncing fire baby — tap to switch colors and pass matching gates.
fireSafetyLesson: Fire needs heat, fuel, and oxygen — remove one and the fire goes out!
title: MAGMA BLOCK BREAKER

description: Tap anywhere to boost the bouncing fireball — keep it out of the lava!
fireSafetyLesson: Never touch hot stoves or ovens — ask a grown-up for help!
title: CRATER CATCHER

description: Drag your paddle to return the ember — beat the storm AI to 7 points.
fireSafetyLesson: In a storm, stay indoors away from windows!
title: ASH STORM SURVIVOR

description: Steer your fire-mobile around the lava track for 3 laps.
fireSafetyLesson: Never play near hot stoves! Stay 3 feet away!
title: LAVA LINE DRAW

description: Drag the basket to catch crystals and avoid rocks.
fireSafetyLesson: If you smell smoke, get low and get out fast!
title: PYRA PADDLE BATTLE

description: Drag to aim the cannon, release to fire at rock targets with wind physics.
fireSafetyLesson: Never aim fireworks at people — only grown-ups handle them!
title: EMBER BOUNCE 2D

description: Tap pipes to rotate and connect lava flow from volcano to crystal.
fireSafetyLesson: Hot pipes can burn — never touch pipes that feel hot!
title: THERMAL TUG-OF-WAR

description: Watch the lightning sequence, then repeat it by tapping in order.
fireSafetyLesson: Lightning is electricity — go inside during thunderstorms!
title: BLAZE'S JUMP QUEST
